name: web-zoom-parallax-scroll-demo-with-scattered-photo-tiles-under-bold-headline
title: 'Scroll Down for Zoom Parallax' heading over an arrangement of city photos and a blue gradient tile at different scales
whatItIs: A white page with a bold black heading and a soft grey halo, and below it a loose collage of rectangles: a blue-teal gradient tile at the left, a street photo in the centre and photos of skyscrapers and a mountain sunset at the right, cut by the frame edge, showing the start of a zoom effect.
whatItMeans: Kinetic and layered; tiles at different sizes suggest depth once they scale on scroll.
techniques: Place tiles at different sizes and offsets.
Scale them on scroll for depth.

vocabulary.definition: Layers scaling at different rates while scrolling.
Items cut by the viewport edge.
